runtime_binding.json.note: Binds operator-supplied evidence hashes; this command does not itself perform GPU or sandbox validation.

operator_deviations.json.cause: Metadata extraction attempted to overwrite identical read-only pinned base rows and failed; the next orchestrated tool call launched the driver before the binding write had succeeded. Corrected extraction skips byte-identical files.
operator_deviations.json.interpretation: Consolidated runtime-binding file was written shortly after the driver started, rather than before it. Scientific source/configuration and all referenced evidence already existed unchanged. Retain this ordering deviation; do not claim exact pre-launch binding for this run.
